main_text.p: nuncupat, Psal.69.13. Ac ex professo de eo tempore agitur Psal.102.13. de quo non fter Propheta: Itaque tu exurgens miseraberis Sion: quia tempus miserendi eius: quia venit statutum tempus.
4. Deliberatione autem a malis, & bonorum corporalium & spiritualium communicatione, accipi debent voces illae: Viuificare: Notam facere clementiam: In ira recordari misericordiae.
main_text.head: 2. SENTENTIA.
main_text.p: Psalmi istius πρόθεσιν[?], supplici precatione enunciatam, hic uersiculus tradit:

O' Iehouah, etsi uehementer afficior triftisima denunciatione de populi tui castigatione, quam uideo ineuitabilem esse: tamen fiducia misericordiae tuae confirmatus, te supplex oro, ut populum tuum, quem tanto studio & tot iam seculis formasti & conseruasti, ut esset peculium tuum, in medijs afflictionibus uiuificare, inq; iusta tua ira misericordiae tuae meminisse uelis.
Hic habetis pij hominis, expauescentis ob conscientiam publicorum & priuatorum peccatorum & malorum, ac eorū acerbisimum sensum, & tamen fide sese erigen-

page.notes: Greek word after "istius" is doubtful; read as πρόθεσιν. "clementiamt" in paragraph 4 appears to be clementiam with a stray letter, kept as printed in the transcription. "inq;" is printed as such and left unexpanded. The long s is rendered as s throughout, so "Pfalmi", "Pfal." and "fenfum" were read as Psalmi, Psal. and sensum. "priua torum" and "memi nisse" are line-end breaks without a printed hyphen, joined. The page shows show-through from the reverse side, which was ignored.
